title: fix(app-shell)!: Home no longer offers Build with AI or Build an app
body:
repo:objectstack#4 · os-justin · session_01QSeKYnagJvGbCtNg2PhvgW
Fixes #37227

Clause-②: yes (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — no skill or doc teaches the two Home entries or the phone welcome copy; `git grep` of `skills/` and `content/docs/` finds none of them or the retired keys

## 维护者速读

- 手机首页、以及电脑上「暂无应用」页面,不再出现「用 AI 搭建」和「搭建应用」两个入口;部署了构建智能体时,手机上「暂无应用」的欢迎语改为普通文案,不再承诺「用 AI 搭建」。「新建空白应用」「从模板开始」和其它入口照旧。
- 落实维护者「两个入口一并去掉」的裁决,以及席位关于欢迎文案的裁决,属于 Studio 首页收口这条主线。
- 若出错,用户会看到缺了一个本该保留的入口、删掉的入口又出现,或欢迎文案不对;改动只删不加,撤回即可恢复。
- 无。

## What changes

- `HomePage.tsx`
  - The greeting row's agent-present build chip, 「Build an app」 (to bare `/studio`), is gone. The no-agent form, 「New blank app」 (`home.build.inStudio`), is untouched: label, key, condition and target are exactly as on main.
  - `HomeAiActions` no longer draws 「Build with AI」. 「Ask AI」 keeps exactly the gate it had: hidden for a maker the build agent serves (the cloud#1674 convergence), shown otherwise.
  - The phone zero-app admin welcome, where the build agent is deployed, now shows `home.noAppsTitle` and the existing NoBuild/NoAi description, not 「Build your business system with AI」 and "Describe your business in one sentence — AI generates …". Without the build agent the welcome is unchanged. No new key is added.
  - The desktop no-apps empty state is not changed here. Since #37166 the shared 「Add app」 list holds no 「Build with AI」 door, so the doors are `new-in-studio`, `template`, `marketplace`. The page-side filter from the earlier head was a no-op after the merge and is removed.
  - Doc comments that described the two entries are rewritten.
- `QuickActions.tsx`: comment only (the component has no call site).
- Retired from all eleven locale packs, each released in 18.6.0 and with zero readers on the merged tree: `home.build.title`, `home.buildWithAI` (its last reader was this page's CTA; #37166 removed the sidebar's) and `home.welcomeAdminDescription`. `home.build.inStudio`, `home.welcome` and `home.build.noCapability` stay; they are still read.
- Changeset `37227-home-drop-build-entries.md`: `Clause-②: yes (narrowing)`, the three keys under 「Removed translation keys」, `not-required (no-migration-prescription)` disposition.

## Overlap and ordering

Answering the landed notice 7169175122 (body refreshed 2026-11-25T19:21Z): #37166 merged first (fbb62e1cc). This branch merged `origin/main` (merge commit b1f7c487d, no rebase). Two test files conflicted and keep both PRs' pins:
- `HomePage.desktopNoApps-36732`: #37166's doors list `[new-in-studio, template, marketplace]` and its Setup → Packages target are kept. This PR adds two assertions: no 「Build with AI」 label and no bare `/studio` door.
- `HomePage.noAgentsBuildChip-26614`: #37166's `setupPair` state and its Studio-only author case (to `~all`) are kept, beside this PR's `answered` latch and `catalogAnswered()`.

`overlap-check` at the new head: VERDICT clean (origin/main; no open PR shares a file).

## Tests

- `HomePage.noAgentsBuildChip-26614`: with the build agent in the catalog, no build chip of either form, for a maker and for a session that may not author, and for the legacy build-agent id. Each absence is read after the catalog stand-in has answered.
- `HomePage.desktopNoApps-36732`: as above.
- `HomePage.authoringCapabilityGate`: the gate acts on 「Start with a template」. The capability-present case pins both entries absent. The phone zero-app welcome pins `home.noAppsTitle` + NoAi and no `home.welcome`.
- `HomePage.phoneTapTargets-29147`: the phone-target case pins both entries absent. A new top-level describe covers the phone zero-app admin welcome: build agent → `noAppsTitle` + NoAi; build + ask → `noAppsTitle` + NoBuild; CONTROL with no agent → `home.welcome` + NoAi.
- `HomePage.greetingAndApps-12601`: build-chip assertions move to the template chip.
- `HomePage.aiStudioDisabled`, `HomePage.marketplaceDisabled`: their catalog is a custom agent, so the chip these flags gate is 「New blank app」.

## Acceptance notes

- `homeAffordancesFollowDeclaration-7256`, `landingHomeParity-7256`, `homeRecoveryRedirectsFollowDeclaration-7373`, `useHomePath.test`, `homePath.test` and `workspaceAdminPositions-5389` mention 「Build an app」 only in prose about a past defect, and assert nothing about the chip.
- The earlier head's gap note (no button on an aiStudio + build-agent + no-marketplace no-apps state) is closed by #37166: 「New blank app」 now shows there on every deployment with AI Studio.

## Verification

Two-minute check: run `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/console/home/`. All files pass. No assertion finds `home-build-app` or `home-build-with-ai` on the page, and the phone zero-app welcome with the build agent reads `«home.noAppsTitle»`.

Read first, by risk:
1. `HomePage.tsx`, the admin zero-app welcome: the title and description branches.
2. `HomePage.tsx` `HomeAiActions`: the early return `if (!askAvailable || maker) return null`, which keeps the 「Ask AI」 gate byte-equivalent.
3. The two merge-resolved test files (above).
